title: SECTION J - Tachometer - Lights do not dim when light and rheostat S/W turned ON

content.caption: Trouble Section
rows: Tachometer | Lights do not dim when light and rheostat S/W turned ON.

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for tachometer dimming issue

steps.text: With the ignition S/W at ON position, light S/W turned ON and rheostat turned to MAX, is there 3 to 5V between terminals 4 and 6 of tachometer connector?

content.text:
NOTE:
Connector dimming is performed by the dim signal (Dim②) of the speedometer.

content.description: Wiring diagram showing tachometer connections with light switch positions (MIN/Bright to OFF to ON to MAX/Fade) and connections to GND and Dim ② terminal. Shows terminals 4 and 6 on connector.
